video_title: Head Coach Jordan Ott Postgame Media Availability | 10-5-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the chaotic final moments of the game
quotes.excerpt: It was big chaotic, just the whole end of the game.
quotes.quote: It was big chaotic, just the whole end of the game, but we picked up. We knew we needed to. We actually watched some clips of that today, knowing that we're in a situation to foul, but we still have an opportunity to go for the basketball, especially there in the front court or in the back court the whole way up there.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the chaotic final minutes of the game: It was big chaotic, just the whole end of the game, but we picked up. We knew we needed to.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the defensive intensity of the first half
quotes.excerpt: That was the defensive intensity that we want to bring every night.
quotes.quote: I think the whole second half, two things can be true. First half, that was the defensive intensity that we want to bring every night. I thought Dylan was fantastic on the ball, Jaylen was great defensively. Just our overall intent defensively was at a high level in the first half.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott praised the defensive intensity in the first half, specifically highlighting the play of Dylan and Jaylen.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the opponent's defensive pressure and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: They forced us into turnovers. It wasn't like we weren't trying.
quotes.quote: They forced us into turnovers. It wasn't like we weren't trying. It was just their pressure really bothered us and that's great reps. Not every team plays with this type of defensive intent, but they do it up and down their roster and that's how we want to be.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott credited the opponent's defensive pressure for forcing turnovers, noting that not every team plays with that level of intent.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the decision to start Ighodaro
quotes.excerpt: He was really good last year. Top 10 defensive center.
quotes.quote: He was really good last year. Top 10 defensive center. We go into all of it. He was great last year, love where he's headed, and then we love where my man's going. In these types of situations, we get to see both.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the decision to start Ighodaro: He was really good last year. Top 10 defensive center. We go into all of it. He was great last year, love where he's headed.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the rotation and the need for Kennedy
quotes.excerpt: We needed Kennedy. That was one that was kind of off script there in the fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: We needed Kennedy. That was one that was kind of off script there in the fourth quarter just with their pressure and extra ball handler where you can just abandon the play and just get into the paint. But yeah, first half that was according to plan.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott explained that using Kennedy in the fourth quarter was off script, necessitated by the opponent's pressure and the need for an extra ball handler.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Bridges' playmaking and defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: We'll continue to highlight his strengths.
quotes.quote: We'll continue to highlight his strengths. I thought his fitting his very first basket I believe was on the glass. We're asking him to do that. Defensively, he's going to guard them all. He's going to guard everyone out there. He's really good in transition as we transition to offense. His ability to get it and go really allows us to play in a ton of space without even having to get to the next advantage. He has the advantage every time he touches it on the defensive glass.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on Bridges: Defensively, he's going to guard them all. He's going to guard everyone out there. His ability to get it and go really allows us to play in a ton of space.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Brooks' role and catch-and-shoot opportunities
quotes.excerpt: We just want Dylan to be Dylan.
quotes.quote: We just want Dylan to be Dylan. He knows, he's been around the league, I think this is year 10, so he's seen a bunch of different situations. Tonight was catch and shoot. When we were here in January, we needed him more than catch and shoot because of some injuries. He knows how to feel it out. We have a lot of scorers, especially because we kept that group kind of the same for most of the first half and he was able to find his spots.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on Dylan Brooks: We just want Dylan to be Dylan. He knows how to feel it out. We have a lot of scorers and he was able to find his spots.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the experimental nature of early season rotations
quotes.excerpt: Right now we're just trying to get minutes.
quotes.quote: There's probably some of that, Dwayne, that's scripted on purpose. But right now we're just trying to get minutes. Trying to get minutes, build them up for conditioning standpoint, keep them healthy, and we wanted to play all their minutes in the first half. That'll change as it progresses, but trying to figure out who plays with who, that's what this is all about right now.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on early season rotations: We are just trying to get minutes, build them up for conditioning, keep them healthy, and figure out who plays with who.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Jaylen's athleticism and aggressive downhill play
quotes.excerpt: Him and Miles in transition really open things up.
quotes.quote: Him and Miles in transition really open things up. Their athleticism and then he was able to get downhill. I thought multiple times, especially against pressure teams like that, that's super helpful, not only as a ball handler, but again, playing through our bigs maybe a little bit more and then using him as a cutter. Just his aggressiveness to downhill, another guy we want to get in the paint, we're trying to prioritize getting into the paint and he can do it at multiple levels.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott praised Jaylen's athleticism and aggressive downhill play, noting his ability to get into the paint at multiple levels.
